title: Tool-Use Anomaly Baselines: Establishing Normal vs. Anomalous Tool-Call Patterns for Agentic Safety

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Establishes empirical grounding for tool-call anomaly detection, which is widely recommended but not yet validated. A public baseline dataset and simple anomaly detection method would directly accelerate the field.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Generating 500 agent trajectories across 5-10 task types, logging all tool calls, computing statistical baselines, and then generating malicious trajectories is a large infrastructure effort. Even with ControlArena, beginners would struggle with the data pipeline.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 500 trajectories across 5-10 task types, statistical baseline computation, malicious trajectory generation, and z-score anomaly detection. This is effectively a dataset creation plus analysis project that exceeds 30 hours for beginners.
